description: Python firmware ELF readers' outcomes. images holds each real image as hexadecimal bytes, with its SHA-256 and how it was built; the sweep numbers them linked 0, firmware 1. admit is admit_elf's outcome for the reservation [address, size] (by default the firmware RAM), symbols is read_symbols' outcome; a refusal is an index into texts. symbols_sha256 hashes each symbol in table order: its name's length as a little-endian 32-bit word, the ASCII name, value and size as 64-bit words, type as a byte and section as a 16-bit word. A named case changes an image by [offset, hex] edits, cuts it to length, pads it with zeros to pad bytes or changes the reservation. Each sweep row is [image index, offset, hex, admit, symbols], with null where an outcome equals the unchanged image's.
